static_review.abi: Both public client and backend headers compare byte-for-byte equal to canonical v1. FFmpeg v7 still owns its existing AVFrame destination and copies no hardware handle.
static_review.peer_identity: Client preconnect validates dedicated non-root service account, runtime directory and socket owner, SO_PEERCRED uid/pid; server checks allowed client uid before setup.
static_review.shared_object: Producer makes one ordinary memfd per peer, fixed3110400B, NOEXEC_SEAL and shrink/grow/future-write/seal protections. Producer retains its existing RW map; receiver validates metadata/device/inode/owner/seals/CLOEXEC then makes RO+DONTFORK map and closes descriptor.
static_review.publication: Broker memcpy ordinary backend frame to per-peer shared slot finishes before release fence and metadata response; frame is freed afterward. Receiver holds global client API mutex across request, metadata validation, acquire fence and memcpy into caller-owned destination. Next request acknowledges copy completion.
static_review.bounds: Dimensions, evenness, exact I420 bytes, capacity, active session and dimensions, color enums, sequence/version/status/reserved fields are validated before copying.
static_review.cleanup: Malformed setup/reply and transfer failure disconnect and unmap; received descriptor ownership is closed on every rejected ancillary path. Producer peer memory not reused for another connection.
static_review.service_compatibility: Existing service uses t736-cedar and runtime0750, AF_UNIX, no-new-privileges, MemoryMax512M; package has no installer. Matched v2 broker/client must start together; old protocol is refused.
static_review.finding: No blocking source defect identified for the intended retained single-codec experiment.

independent_test.method: Include unmodified actual client and a software ordinary-memfd setup peer; real Linux SCM_RIGHTS, mmap, fork, exec and pthread mutex. No vendor backend/socket service/device.
cases: Fork while parent deliberately holds the actual client mutex: every child API returns unavailable/ENOTCONN before lock, guarded by3-second alarm.
Child sends no socket bytes and leaves output buffers/frame metadata untouched.
MADV_DONTFORK removes client mapping in child. Reuse the same address for a new private allocation; child client_exit closes inherited socket without unmapping new allocation.
Repeated destructor is safe. Parent mapping and socket remain valid and see subsequent producer writes.
Exec closes inherited client connection via FD_CLOEXEC and no active client state survives.
Open fd count returns to baseline.

limits: Native fork test does not exercise Firefox RDD sandbox on the board.
SHM still makes two ordinary RAM copies after backend output; no zero-copy or performance claim.
MFD_NOEXEC_SEAL availability must be verified on target; unsupported setup fails closed into existing pre-delivery fallback.
Whole v7 chain remains below target fps on current hardware; source/host test success is not playback acceptance.

package_audit.board_dependency_reported_by_root: v28 CONFIG_ADVISE_SYSCALLS is unset; madvise(MADV_DONTFORK) returns ENOSYS, so v2 correctly rejects setup. Independent v29 configuration-only rebuild in progress. No unsafe downgrade.
